tasks.title: Add bilingual routing (/en/, /pt/) with browser language detection and ADR
acceptance: docs/adr/0002-i18n-routing.md records the decision (locales en and pt-BR, static pages at /en/ and /pt/, detection rule, fallback en, same section anchors in both locales) with a 'Quando reabrir' section

yarn build emits dist/en/index.html with <html lang="en"> and dist/pt/index.html with <html lang="pt-BR">, each with its own title, meta description, og:locale and <link rel="alternate" hreflang> for en, pt-BR and x-default
dist/index.html sends visitors whose preferred browser language starts with 'pt' to /pt/ and everyone else to /en/, preserving the URL hash, and without JavaScript shows plain links to both versions

src/lib/ exports a typed Locale ('en' | 'pt-BR') and a function that resolves the locale from the pathname (unknown path resolves to en), and the app mounts with the locale of the page it was loaded from
yarn typecheck, yarn lint and yarn build pass
notes: 2026-11-24 rodada 4 (PO): stakeholder decision (REPORT 24/11): bilingual pt-BR + en, browser detection with en fallback, visible selector, routes /pt and /en, P0. Static multi-page output chosen over client-side routing so each locale has its own lang and meta without JS.
